description: The movie-search requests of the reference application, over the frozen movies fixture. Expected IDs are derived from the corpus and confirmed against both references; scores are never compared.

cases.description: Plain words use OR: space-only, adventure-only and both-term documents all match, including through the content field.
A quoted phrase matches the words in sequence, across the punctuation of Spider-Man; spider-like does not match.
+ between terms requires both: only the document with space and adventure matches.
-horror excludes the spider document about horror; with an exclusion the positive term stays mandatory (default_operator AND).
The positive phrase stays mandatory and every document mentioning Homecoming is excluded, including one that only mentions it.
A trailing * matches by prefix.
~2 allows two edits: avengrs finds The Avengers.
amelie matches Amélie, and the highlight keeps the original accented text.
A terms filter on the genres keyword keeps only Science Fiction among the space matches.
A range filter keeps ratings >= 7, including exactly 7.0 and excluding 6.99; browse order is popularity, then tmdb_id.
match_all sorted by popularity desc, then tmdb_id asc as a keyword: ties order by string, so 999 sorts after 2002. Facets cover the whole corpus.
from and size page through the deterministic browse order.
_source includes return only the listed fields.
_count with a filter returns the number of matching documents.
The completion suggester returns Spider-Man for spi, without duplicate texts, at most size options.
Incomplete user input ("Spider-Man) with lenient: true is answered with 200, never a 5xx; the matches are recorded by the baseline.
Incomplete user input ("Spider-Man" -) with lenient: true is answered with 200, never a 5xx; the matches are recorded by the baseline.
Incomplete user input (title:(Spider) with lenient: true is answered with 200, never a 5xx; the matches are recorded by the baseline.
The title.keyword multi-field matches the exact, unanalyzed title only.
match with operator and requires every analyzed term in the field.
multi_match best_fields with operator and needs both terms in one field: only Space Adventure has both in its title.
minimum_should_match 2 of three genre clauses: only movies with at least two of Action, Adventure and Comedy.
Without size, a search returns the first 10 hits; the total still counts every match.
